firm_data.firm_description: Napierski, VanDenburgh, Napierski & O’Connor, LLP is a premier civil litigation firm that provides legal services in Albany, NY. They offer practice areas such as medical malpractice defense, insurance defense, construction accident & defect, employment discrimination & sexual harassment, and planning, prevention & training.
notable_facts: The firm is affiliated with Super Lawyers, Eagle Insurance Group, New York State Academy of Trial Lawyers, American College of Trial Lawyers, and Defense Research Institute.
The firm has received the Martindale-Hubbell rating of AV, which includes only firms with the highest level of legal ability and ethical standards.
